"""Phase-granted matched-parent controls; no retry or inferred phase waiver."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import support as common
import census
P = json.loads((ROOT / 'execution-plan.json').read_text())
CASES = json.loads(Path(P['cases_file']).read_text())
BASE = Path(P['baseline_worktree'])
CURRENT = Path(P['current_worktree'])
TARGET = Path(P['target'])
RUN = ROOT / 'run'
LINT = ROOT.parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('approved_full_gate', LINT / 'full-gates/run-full-gates.py')
gate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(gate)
core = gate.core

def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p, v): common.write_json(p, v)
def info(p):
    p = Path(p)
    s = p.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink(), p
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(p), 'sha256': common.sha(b), 'bytes': len(b), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}
def verify(expected):
    actual = info(expected['path'])
    assert actual == {k: expected[k] for k in actual}, expected

def environment(current=False):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for k, v in P['current_environment' if current else 'environment'].items():
        if v is None: env.pop(k, None)
        else: env[k] = v
    for k in list(env):
        if k.startswith(('CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_', 'CARGO_TARGET_ARM_')): env.pop(k)
    env['PATH'] = '/Users/autonomous/.cargo/bin' + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
    return env

def guard_source(wt, filename):
    expected = load(filename)
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=wt).decode().strip() == P['head']
    for row in expected['paths']:
        path = wt / row['path']
        s = path.lstat()
        raw = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if path.is_symlink() else path.read_bytes()
        actual = {'path': row['path'], 'kind': 'symlink' if path.is_symlink() else 'file',
                  'sha256': common.sha(raw), 'bytes': len(raw), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), 'mtime_ns': s.st_mtime_ns}
        assert actual == row, row['path']
    if wt == BASE:
        assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'branch', '--show-current'], cwd=wt).decode().strip() == P['branch']
        assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=wt) == b''

def guards():
    guard_source(BASE, P['baseline_guard'])
    guard_source(CURRENT, P['source_guard'])
    for row in CASES: verify(row['current_binding']['readonly_witness'])
    assert Path(shutil.which('cat', path=environment()['PATH'])).resolve() == Path('/bin/cat').resolve()
    assert Path(shutil.which('cat', path=environment(True)['PATH'])).resolve() == Path('/bin/cat').resolve()
    for row in load(P['child_bindings'])['system']:
        verify({**row, 'path': row['resolved_path']})
    for row in load(P['child_bindings'])['memory']:
        assert info(row['reader_snapshot'])['sha256'] == row['reader_sha256']
        assert info(row['workspace_snapshot'])['sha256'] == row['workspace_sha256']

def owned(argv, cwd, env, folder, label, timeout):
    # Even setup/list/compile commands have an irreversible launch receipt.
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (folder / (label + '.consumed.json')).open('x') as f:
        json.dump({'argv': argv, 'at': common.now(), 'allocation_consumed_before_launch': True}, f)
    print(json.dumps({'launch': label, 'argv': argv, 'folder': str(folder)}), flush=True)
    record = common.run_command(argv, cwd, env, folder, label, timeout)
    print(json.dumps({'closed': label, 'exit_code': record['exit_code'], 'timed_out': record['timed_out']}), flush=True)
    assert record['owned_group_absent_after_cleanup']
    assert record['direct_wait_status'] == record['exit_code']
    return record

def metadata():
    f = RUN / 'metadata'
    r = owned(P['commands']['metadata'], BASE / 'lampOS', environment(), f, 'metadata', 300)
    common.require_success(r)
    raw = load(f / r['stdout'])
    frozen = load(P['frozen_metadata'])
    def normalize(v, root):
        v = json.loads(json.dumps(v).replace(str(root), '<source-root>'))
        v['target_directory'] = '<target-root>'
        v['build_directory'] = '<target-root>'
        return v
    assert Path(raw['target_directory']).resolve() == TARGET
    assert Path(raw['build_directory']).resolve() == TARGET
    # Preserve complete registry/git identities, versions, fragments and graph edges.
    assert normalize(raw, BASE) == normalize(frozen, CURRENT)
    packages = [x for x in raw['packages'] if x['source'] is None]
    assert len(packages) == 48
    assert all(Path(x['manifest_path']).is_relative_to(BASE) for x in packages)
    expected = load(P['local_package_file'])
    assert {x['id'] for x in packages} == {x['id'] for x in expected['packages']}
    for x in expected['packages']:
        assert common.sha(Path(x['manifest_path']).read_bytes()) == x['manifest_sha256']
    save(RUN / 'actual-metadata-proof.json', {'package_ids': [x['id'] for x in packages],
         'raw_metadata_sha256': common.sha((f / r['stdout']).read_bytes()), 'complete_normalized_equality': True})

def compile_parent():
    ids = load(RUN / 'actual-metadata-proof.json')['package_ids']
    assert set(ids) == {x['id'] for x in load(P['local_package_file'])['packages']}
    assert set(P['commands']['clean'][5::2]) == set(ids)
    r = owned(P['commands']['clean'], BASE / 'lampOS', environment(), RUN / 'compile', 'clean', 600)
    common.require_success(r)
    # Reuse reviewed raw-ID/current-source/full-context ledger, initially empty.
    core.WT, core.TARGET = BASE, TARGET
    gate.WT, gate.TARGET = BASE, TARGET
    gate.LOCAL = {x['id']: x for x in load(P['local_package_file'])['packages']}
    gate.LEDGER, gate.LATEST = {}, {}
    gate.ROOT = RUN / 'compile'
    gate.SEED = {'source_guard_sha256': common.sha(Path(P['baseline_guard']).read_bytes())}
    bindings = {}
    for name in ['voice-no-run', 'readers-no-run']:
        folder = RUN / 'compile' / name
        r = owned(P['commands'][name], BASE / 'lampOS', environment(), folder, name, 3600)
        common.require_success(r)
        proof = gate.compile_records(r, folder)
        # Every first local context must have fresh:false; reuse has full unit/output proof.
        for b in proof:
            a = b['compiler_artifact']
            if a.get('executable') and a['profile']['test']:
                for case in CASES:
                    old = case['current_binding']['binding']['compiler_artifact']
                    if core.unit_key(a) == json.dumps([old['package_id'].replace('path+' + CURRENT.as_uri(), 'path+file://<source-root>'), old['target']['kind'], old['target']['name'], old['target']['crate_types'], old['profile'], sorted(old.get('features', []))], sort_keys=True):
                        assert a['target'] == json.loads(json.dumps(old['target']).replace(str(CURRENT), str(BASE)))
                        bindings[case['name']] = {'executable': a['executable'], 'sha256': info(a['executable'])['sha256'], 'compiler_artifact': a}
    assert len(bindings) == 10
    save(RUN / 'parent-bindings.json', bindings)
    save(RUN / 'sealed-outputs.json', list(gate.LATEST.values()))

def sealed():
    for row in load(RUN / 'sealed-outputs.json'): verify(row)

def inventory():
    sealed()
    bindings = load(RUN / 'parent-bindings.json')
    unique = {x['executable']: x for x in bindings.values()}
    assert len(unique) == 6
    f = RUN / 'inventory'
    f.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    entries = census.case_census(list(unique.values()), {'packages': sorted({x['package'] for x in CASES})}, environment(), f, BASE)
    for case in CASES:
        found = [e for e in entries if e['executable'] == bindings[case['name']]['executable']]
        assert len(found) == 1
        current = case['current_census']
        for key in ['compiled_cases', 'compiled_ignored_cases']:
            assert found[0][key] == current[key], (case['name'], key)
        assert found[0]['compiled_cases'].count(case['name']) == 1
        assert case['name'] not in found[0]['compiled_ignored_cases']
    sealed()
    save(RUN / 'inventory-proof.json', {'six_contexts_census_equal': True, 'ten_named_cases_once': True})

def swap(row, direction):
    source = Path(row['reader_snapshot'] if direction == 'reader' else row['workspace_snapshot'])
    wanted = row['reader_sha256'] if direction == 'reader' else row['workspace_sha256']
    path = Path(row['primary']); before = info(path)
    assert before['sha256'] in [row['reader_sha256'], row['workspace_sha256']]
    assert before['mode'] == row['original_mode']
    if before['sha256'] != wanted:
        raw = source.read_bytes(); assert common.sha(raw) == wanted
        tmp = path.with_name('.' + path.name + '.parent-control-' + str(os.getpid()) + '-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        try:
            with tmp.open('xb') as f: f.write(raw); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
            os.chmod(tmp, row['original_mode']); os.replace(tmp, path)
        finally:
            if tmp.exists(): tmp.unlink()
    after = info(path)
    assert after['sha256'] == wanted and after['mode'] == row['original_mode']
    return {'direction': direction, 'before': before, 'after': after}

def observe(current, approval):
    assert load(RUN / 'inventory-proof.json')['ten_named_cases_once']
    names = approval.get('unmatched_cases', []) if current else [x['name'] for x in CASES]
    assert len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) <= {x['name'] for x in CASES}
    if current:
        assert names
        review = load(approval['phase_review'])
        assert common.sha(Path(approval['phase_review']).read_bytes()) == approval['phase_review_sha256']
        assert set(names) == set(review['unmatched_cases'])
        assert review['baseline_results_sha256'] == common.sha((RUN / 'baseline/results.json').read_bytes())
        assert load(RUN / 'baseline/results.json')['completed'] == 10
    folder = RUN / ('current' if current else 'baseline')
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    state = {'observations': [], 'completed': 0, 'planned': len(names) * (3 if current else 1), 'restoration': []}
    save(folder / 'results.json', state)
    children = load(P['child_bindings'])['memory'] if current and any(n.startswith(('health::', 'voice::')) for n in names) else []
    signals = {signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM}
    handlers = {s: signal.getsignal(s) for s in signals}
    def interrupted(sig, frame): raise InterruptedError(signal.Signals(sig).name)
    for s in signals: signal.signal(s, interrupted)
    try:
        for row in children:
            assert info(row['primary'])['sha256'] == row['workspace_sha256']
            state['restoration'].append(swap(row, 'reader')); save(folder / 'results.json', state)
        for case in CASES:
            if case['name'] not in names: continue
            for repetition in range(1, 4 if current else 2):
                guards()
                if not current: sealed()
                for row in children:
                    assert info(row['primary'])['sha256'] == row['reader_sha256']
                b = case['current_binding']['readonly_witness'] if current else load(RUN / 'parent-bindings.json')[case['name']]
                exe = b['path'] if current else b['executable']
                assert info(exe)['sha256'] == b['sha256']
                slot = folder / f"{CASES.index(case)+1:02d}-{repetition}"
                cwd = (CURRENT if current else BASE) / Path(case['source_manifest']).parent
                r = owned([exe, '--exact', case['name']], cwd, environment(current), slot, 'exact', P['outer_seconds'])
                assert not r['timed_out'] and r['exit_code'] in [0, 101]
                summary = census.execution_summary(r, slot)
                assert summary['totals']['passed'] + summary['totals']['failed'] == 1 and summary['totals']['ignored'] == 0
                names_seen = re.findall(r'^test (.+) \.\.\. (ok|FAILED)$', (slot / r['stdout']).read_text(), re.M)
                assert names_seen == [(case['name'], 'ok' if r['exit_code'] == 0 else 'FAILED')]
                guards()
                if not current: sealed()
                for row in children:
                    assert info(row['primary'])['sha256'] == row['reader_sha256']
                    assert info(row['primary'])['mode'] == row['original_mode']
                state['observations'].append({'name': case['name'], 'repetition': repetition, 'record': r, 'outcome': names_seen[0][1], 'folder': str(slot)})
                state['completed'] += 1
                save(folder / 'results.json', state)
    finally:
        blocked = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, signals)
        try:
            errors = []
            for row in reversed(children):
                try: state['restoration'].append(swap(row, 'workspace'))
                except BaseException as exc: errors.append(repr(exc))
            state['restoration_errors'] = errors
            state['workspace_paths_restored'] = not errors and all(info(row['primary'])['sha256'] == row['workspace_sha256'] and info(row['primary'])['mode'] == row['original_mode'] for row in children)
            try: guards()
            except BaseException as exc: errors.append('final source/witness guard: ' + repr(exc))
            save(folder / 'results.json', state)
        finally:
            for s, handler in handlers.items(): signal.signal(s, handler)
            signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK, blocked)
        assert not errors and state['workspace_paths_restored']
    assert state['completed'] == state['planned']

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['metadata', 'compile', 'inventory', 'baseline', 'current'], required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--approval', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(); approval = load(args.approval)
    assert approval['phase'] == args.phase
    assert approval['controller_sha256'] == common.sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    assert approval['plan_sha256'] == common.sha((ROOT / 'execution-plan.json').read_bytes())
    assert approval['manifest_sha256'] == common.sha((ROOT / 'input-manifest.json').read_bytes())
    for file, digest in load(ROOT / 'input-manifest.json')['inputs'].items():
        assert common.sha(Path(file).read_bytes()) == digest, file
    guards()
    handlers = {sig: signal.getsignal(sig) for sig in [signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM]}
    def interrupted(sig, frame): raise InterruptedError(signal.Signals(sig).name)
    for sig in handlers: signal.signal(sig, interrupted)
    RUN.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with (RUN / (args.phase + '.consumed.json')).open('x') as f:
        json.dump({'at': common.now(), 'approval': approval}, f)
    try:
        if args.phase == 'metadata': metadata()
        elif args.phase == 'compile': compile_parent()
        elif args.phase == 'inventory': inventory()
        else: observe(args.phase == 'current', approval)
        guards()
        save(RUN / (args.phase + '.terminal.json'), {'valid_complete': True, 'finished_at': common.now()})
    except BaseException as exc:
        save(RUN / (args.phase + '.terminal.json'), {'valid_complete': False, 'error': repr(exc), 'no_retry': True})
        raise
    finally:
        for sig, handler in handlers.items(): signal.signal(sig, handler)

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Persistent qualification proof helpers; new wrapper identity, recovered strict proof bodies."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import support as common
SUMMARY = re.compile(r'^test result: (ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out[^\n]*', re.MULTILINE)

def package_name(package_id):
    # New Cargo path IDs contain #name@version; retain the raw ID as authority.
    return package_id.rsplit('#', 1)[-1].split('@', 1)[0]

def artifacts(record, folder, target, source_digest):
    records = {}
    for line in (folder / record['stdout']).read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get('reason') != 'compiler-artifact' or not value.get('executable'):
            continue
        binary = Path(value['executable']).resolve()
        assert binary.is_relative_to(target), 'Artifact escaped the assigned target'
        if not binary.is_file():
            records[str(binary)] = {'executable': str(binary), 'missing_after_command': True,
                                    'compiler_artifact': value, 'source_aggregate_sha256': source_digest}
            continue
        data = binary.read_bytes()
        records[str(binary)] = {'executable': str(binary), 'sha256': common.sha(data), 'bytes': len(data),
                                'compiler_artifact': value, 'source_aggregate_sha256': source_digest}
    result = list(records.values())
    common.write_json(folder / 'compiled-artifacts.json', result)
    return result

def execution_summary(record, folder):
    # The compiler census is deliberately not used for execution totals.
    text = (folder / record['stdout']).read_text()
    parsed = []
    for match in SUMMARY.finditer(text):
        parsed.append({'raw': match[0], 'status': match[1],
                       **dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out'),
                                  map(int, match.groups()[1:])))})
    summary = {'source': 'actual test result lines only, including any harness-compatible summaries',
               'command_exit_code': record.get('exit_code'), 'command_timed_out': record.get('timed_out'),
               'rows': parsed,
               'totals': {name: sum(row[name] for row in parsed)
                          for name in ('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out')},
               'qualification': 'Nonzero or timeout is still a failed/incomplete gate regardless of parsed counts; compiled inventory is not execution.'}
    common.write_json(folder / 'executed-summaries.json', summary)
    return summary

def compile_outcome(record, folder):
    finished, errors = [], []
    for line in (folder / record['stdout']).read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            continue
        if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
            finished.append(value)
        if value.get('reason') == 'compiler-message' and value.get('message', {}).get('level') == 'error':
            errors.append(value)
    result = {'build_finished_messages': finished, 'compiler_error_messages': errors,
              'successful': bool(finished) and all(row.get('success') is True for row in finished) and not errors}
    common.write_json(folder / 'compilation-outcome.json', result)
    return result

def target_outcomes(record, folder, census, selected_packages, expected_doc_packages, wt):
    # Cargo launches package targets sequentially. Match each launch to exactly
    # one summary, then bind every executable's test rows to its compiled census.
    by_path = {entry['executable']: entry for entry in census}
    stdout = (folder / record['stdout']).read_text()
    stderr = (folder / record['stderr']).read_text()
    summaries = list(SUMMARY.finditer(stdout))
    launches, errors = [], []
    for line in stderr.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r'^\s*Running (.+) \(([^)]+)\)\s*$', line)
        if match:
            path = Path(match[2])
            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = wt / 'lampOS' / path
            key = str(path.resolve())
            entry = by_path.get(key)
            if entry is None:
                errors.append('Cargo launched an uninventoried executable: ' + line)
                launches.append({'kind': 'unknown executable', 'name': match[1], 'executable': key})
            else:
                launches.append({'kind': 'executable', 'package': entry['package'],
                                 'target': entry['target'], 'executable': key, 'sha256': entry['sha256'],
                                 'name': entry['package'] + ':' + '/'.join(entry['target']['kind']) + ':' + entry['target']['name']})
        else:
            match = re.match(r'^\s*Doc-tests ([\w-]+)\s*$', line)
            if match:
                package = match[1].replace('_', '-')
                launches.append({'kind': 'doctests', 'package': package, 'name': package + ':doctests'})
    launched = [row['executable'] for row in launches if row['kind'] == 'executable']
    docs = [row['package'] for row in launches if row['kind'] == 'doctests']
    expected = {path: entry['package'] + ':' + '/'.join(entry['target']['kind']) + ':' + entry['target']['name']
                for path, entry in by_path.items()}
    report = {'targets': launches, 'completed_targets': [], 'passed_targets': [], 'failed_targets': [],
              'unrun_targets': [name for path, name in expected.items() if path not in launched] +
                               [name + ':doctests' for name in expected_doc_packages if name not in docs],
              'incomplete_targets': [], 'binding_errors': errors,
              'compiler_census_is_execution': False, 'complete_binding': False}
    if {entry['package'] for entry in census} != set(selected_packages):
        errors.append('Compiled census does not cover exactly the selected packages')
    if set(launched) != set(by_path) or len(launched) != len(set(launched)):
        errors.append('Cargo launches do not cover the compiled executable census exactly once')
    if sorted(docs) != sorted(expected_doc_packages):
        errors.append('Doctest launches do not match the selected package manifest scope')
    if len(launches) != len(summaries):
        errors.append('Cargo launch/result count mismatch')
        report['incomplete_targets'] = [row['name'] for row in launches]
    else:
        previous = 0
        for target, summary in zip(launches, summaries):
            segment_start = previous
            segment = stdout[previous:summary.start()]
            previous = summary.end()
            row_matches = [(m.start(), m[1], m[2]) for m in re.finditer(
                r'^test (.+) \.\.\. (ok|FAILED|ignored(?:, [^\n]*)?)$', segment, re.MULTILINE)]
            interleaving = []
            # The retained 4a84 stream has exactly this libtest row split by
            # one complete child readiness JSON record, then its actual status.
            # Accept no other case/event shape and retain the original bytes.
            known = 'physical::fake_lamp::recorder_clock_tests::original_argument_failures_precede_files_clock_samples_and_waits'
            pattern = (r'^test ' + re.escape(known) + r' \.\.\. '
                       r'(\{[^\n]*\})\n(ok|FAILED)$(?!\n(?:ok|FAILED|ignored)(?:\n|$))')
            for match in re.finditer(pattern, segment, re.MULTILINE):
                if target['name'] != 'lamp-voice-eval:lib:lamp_voice_eval':
                    continue
                if by_path[target['executable']]['compiled_cases'].count(known) != 1:
                    continue
                try:
                    child = json.loads(match[1], object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                if child != {'seconds': 8, 'status': 'listening_ready'} or type(child.get('seconds')) is not int:
                    continue
                raw = match[0].encode('utf-8')
                offset = len(stdout[:segment_start + match.start()].encode('utf-8'))
                row_matches.append((match.start(), known, match[2]))
                interleaving.append({'case': known, 'status': match[2], 'byte_offset': offset,
                                     'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': common.sha(raw), 'utf8': match[0],
                                     'validated_child_json': child,
                                     'projection': 'test ' + known + ' ... ' + match[2]})
            raw_rows = [(name, status) for _, name, status in sorted(row_matches)]
            rows, annotations = [], []
            for raw_name, status in raw_rows:
                name = raw_name
                if target['kind'] == 'executable':
                    compiled_names = by_path[target['executable']]['compiled_cases']
                    suffix = ' - should panic'
                    # libtest adds this display annotation. Normalize only a
                    # unique compiled identity, never an arbitrary suffix.
                    if raw_name not in compiled_names and raw_name.endswith(suffix):
                        candidate_name = raw_name.removesuffix(suffix)
                        if compiled_names.count(candidate_name) == 1:
                            name = candidate_name
                            annotations.append({'raw_name': raw_name, 'compiled_identity': name,
                                                'display_annotation': suffix})
                rows.append((name, status))
            counts = dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out'), map(int, summary.groups()[1:])))
            target.update(result=summary[1], counts=counts, raw_test_rows=raw_rows,
                          test_rows=rows, display_annotation_mapping=annotations, stdout_interleaving_mapping=interleaving)
            issues = []
            if counts['measured'] != 0 or counts['filtered_out'] != 0:
                issues.append('Full package command unexpectedly filtered or measured tests')
            if len(rows) != counts['passed'] + counts['failed'] + counts['ignored']:
                issues.append('Test-row count does not match the target summary')
            if (sum(status == 'ok' for _, status in rows) != counts['passed']
                    or sum(status == 'FAILED' for _, status in rows) != counts['failed']
                    or sum(status.startswith('ignored') for _, status in rows) != counts['ignored']):
                issues.append('Test-row outcomes do not match the target summary')
            if (summary[1] == 'FAILED') != (counts['failed'] > 0):
                issues.append('Target summary status contradicts its failed count')
            if target['kind'] == 'executable':
                inventory = by_path[target['executable']]
                if sorted(name for name, _ in rows) != inventory['compiled_cases']:
                    issues.append('Executed case names do not match the bound compiled census')
                if sorted(name for name, status in rows if status.startswith('ignored')) != inventory['compiled_ignored_cases']:
                    issues.append('Ignored case names do not match the bound compiled census')
            elif target['kind'] != 'doctests':
                issues.append('Unknown executable has no source/artifact binding')
            if issues:
                errors.extend(target['name'] + ': ' + issue for issue in issues)
                report['incomplete_targets'].append(target['name'])
            else:
                report['completed_targets'].append(target['name'])
                report['failed_targets' if counts['failed'] else 'passed_targets'].append(target['name'])
    report['complete_binding'] = not errors and not report['unrun_targets'] and not report['incomplete_targets']
    common.write_json(folder / 'target-outcomes.json', report)
    return report

def case_census(bindings, plan, env, folder, wt):
    results = []
    # Both custom Update entrypoints explicitly implement list/ignored-list and
    # return before running their Linux process harness; inspected in this base.
    approved_custom = {('lamp-update', 'self-process-cuts'), ('lamp-update', 'self-cli-exec')}
    for binding in bindings:
        message = binding['compiler_artifact']
        package = package_name(message['package_id'])
        target = message['target']
        is_test = message.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
        custom = (package, target['name']) in approved_custom and 'test' in target.get('kind', [])
        if package not in plan['packages'] or not (is_test or custom):
            continue
        assert not binding.get('missing_after_command'), 'Compiled test artifact is missing'
        binary = Path(binding['executable'])
        assert common.sha(binary.read_bytes()) == binding['sha256']
        label = f"{package}-{target['name']}-{binding['sha256'][:10]}"
        entry_folder = folder / 'compiled-census' / label
        entry_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        file_record = common.run_command(['file', str(binary)], wt / 'lampOS', env, entry_folder, 'file', 60)
        common.require_success(file_record)
        listed = common.run_command([str(binary), '--list', '--format', 'terse'], wt / 'lampOS', env,
                                    entry_folder, 'all', 60)
        ignored = common.run_command([str(binary), '--ignored', '--list', '--format', 'terse'],
                                     wt / 'lampOS', env, entry_folder, 'ignored', 60)
        names = common.inventory(listed, entry_folder)
        ignored_names = common.inventory(ignored, entry_folder)
        assert set(ignored_names) <= set(names)
        entry = {'package': package, 'target': target, 'executable': str(binary),
                 'sha256': binding['sha256'], 'compiled_cases': names,
                 'compiled_ignored_cases': ignored_names, 'compiled_case_count': len(names),
                 'ignored_case_count': len(ignored_names), 'custom_entrypoint': custom,
                 'executed_tests_in_this_census': 0}
        common.write_json(entry_folder / 'census.json', entry)
        results.append(entry)
    common.write_json(folder / 'compiled-census.json', results)
    return results

def unique_pairs(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("duplicate child readiness key")
        result[key] = value
    return result

"""Phase-granted component controller; unchanged f40 owns every child group."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import support as common
import census

SCRIPT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN = None
RUN_ROOT = None
WT = None
TARGET = None
ENV = None


def dump(name, value):
    common.write_json(RUN_ROOT / name, value)


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-optional-locks', *args], cwd=WT)


def source_rows():
    rows = []
    for expected in json.loads(Path(PLAN['source_guard']).read_text())['paths']:
        path = WT / expected['path']
        metadata = path.lstat()
        raw = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if path.is_symlink() else path.read_bytes()
        rows.append({'path': expected['path'], 'kind': 'symlink' if path.is_symlink() else 'file',
                     'sha256': common.sha(raw), 'bytes': len(raw),
                     'mode': stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode), 'mtime_ns': metadata.st_mtime_ns})
    return rows


def guard_source():
    expected = json.loads(Path(PLAN['source_guard']).read_text())
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == PLAN['head']
    assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == PLAN['branch']
    assert source_rows() == expected['paths']
    assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only').strip()
    tracked = set(git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines())
    untracked = set(filter(None, git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z').decode().split('\0')))
    assert tracked | untracked == set(PLAN['owned_paths'])
    for path, expected_hash in PLAN['input_hashes'].items():
        assert common.sha(Path(path).read_bytes()) == expected_hash, path
    witness = PLAN['diagnostic_witness']
    path = Path(witness['path'])
    assert common.sha(path.read_bytes()) == witness['sha256']
    assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == 0o555


def artifact(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(TARGET) and path.is_file(), path
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': common.sha(raw),
            'mode': stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)}


def owned(argv, folder, label, timeout):
    record = common.run_command(argv, WT / 'lampOS', ENV, folder, label, timeout)
    assert record['owned_group_absent_after_cleanup']
    assert record['direct_wait_status'] == record['exit_code']
    return record


def normalized_id(raw_id):
    if not raw_id.startswith('path+'):
        return raw_id
    prefix = 'path+' + WT.resolve().as_uri()
    if raw_id.startswith(prefix + '/') or raw_id.startswith(prefix + '#'):
        return 'path+file://<source-root>' + raw_id[len(prefix):]
    raise AssertionError(('unknown local source root', raw_id))


def unit_key(message):
    target = message['target']
    return json.dumps([normalized_id(message['package_id']), target['kind'], target['name'],
                       target['crate_types'], message['profile'], sorted(message.get('features', []))],
                      sort_keys=True)


def compile_provenance(folder, record):
    messages = []
    for line in (folder / record['stdout']).read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            message = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(message, dict):
            messages.append(message)
    local = {p['id']: p for p in json.loads(Path(PLAN['local_package_file']).read_text())['packages']}
    counts = Counter()
    raw_counts = Counter()
    first_fresh = {}
    units, files = [], {}
    for message in messages:
        if message.get('reason') != 'compiler-artifact':
            continue
        key = unit_key(message)
        counts[key] += 1
        raw_counts[message['package_id']] += 1
        package = local.get(message['package_id'])
        if package is None:
            assert not message['package_id'].startswith('path+'), message['package_id']
            continue
        source = Path(message['target']['src_path']).resolve()
        manifest = Path(message['manifest_path']).resolve()
        assert manifest == Path(package['manifest_path']).resolve()
        assert source.is_relative_to(WT) and source.is_file()
        assert common.sha(manifest.read_bytes()) == package['manifest_sha256']
        outputs = [artifact(path) for path in message['filenames']]
        if message['fresh']:
            assert key in first_fresh and first_fresh[key] == outputs, ('unproved local reuse', key)
        else:
            first_fresh[key] = outputs
        for output in outputs:
            assert files.get(output['path'], output) == output
            files[output['path']] = output
        units.append({'message': message, 'unit_key': key, 'current_source_path': str(source),
                      'source_sha256': common.sha(source.read_bytes()), 'outputs': outputs,
                      'first_fresh_false_in_this_compile': key in first_fresh})
    assert units
    scripts = []
    for message in messages:
        if message.get('reason') == 'build-script-executed' and message['package_id'] in local:
            assert Path(message['out_dir']).resolve().is_relative_to(TARGET)
            assert any(u['message']['package_id'] == message['package_id']
                       and 'custom-build' in u['message']['target']['kind']
                       and u['message']['fresh'] is False for u in units)
            scripts.append(message)
    report = {'local_units': units, 'local_build_script_executions': scripts,
              'sealed_outputs': sorted(files.values(), key=lambda x: x['path']),
              'actual_compiler_message_count': sum(counts.values()), 'actual_unique_units': len(counts),
              'actual_unit_message_multiplicities': dict(counts),
              'actual_raw_package_id_message_counts': dict(raw_counts),
              'no_original_e63_baseline_unit_equality_claim': True,
              'provenance_boundary': 'Actual current source/fresh:false CargoJSON + exact unit/profile/features/output identities and retained metadata edges; no consumer --extern argv claim.'}
    common.write_json(folder / 'local-provenance.json', report)
    bindings = census.artifacts(record, folder, TARGET, PLAN['source_guard_sha256'])
    common.write_json(folder / 'bound-artifacts.json', bindings)
    return report


def guard_artifacts():
    report = json.loads((RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile/local-provenance.json').read_text())
    for expected in report['sealed_outputs']:
        assert artifact(expected['path']) == expected
    for binding in json.loads((RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile/bound-artifacts.json').read_text()):
        assert not binding.get('missing_after_command')
        assert common.sha(Path(binding['executable']).read_bytes()) == binding['sha256']


def clean_compile():
    folder = RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    # The readonly completed diagnostic witness is checked BEFORE new clean.
    guard_source()
    result = owned(PLAN['clean_command'], folder, 'clean-local', 600)
    guard_source()
    common.require_success(result)
    dump('actual-clean-receipt.json', {'actual_record': result,
         'selection': 'ALL48 current source=None inside-WT IDs, including excluded Sonora/Tough',
         'semantics_limit': 'Cargo may ignore URL/version qualifiers and clean all cached versions of selected NAMES. No current resolved registry/git collision; historical same-name generated outputs were not independently inventoried. Registry/git source caches are not selected.',
         'source_bytes_full_modes_mtimes_preserved': True})
    result = owned(PLAN['compile_command'], folder, 'compile-no-run', 1800)
    guard_source()
    common.require_success(result)
    assert census.compile_outcome(result, folder)['successful']
    compile_provenance(folder, result)
    guard_artifacts()


def inventory():
    # Whole source + all sealed local artifacts before and after this phase.
    # ONLY selected actual round: file/all/ignored, not58 unrelated targets.
    folder = RUN_ROOT / 'inventory'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    bindings = json.loads((RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile/bound-artifacts.json').read_text())
    update_id = next(p['id'] for p in json.loads(Path(PLAN['local_package_file']).read_text())['packages']
                     if p['name'] == 'lamp-update')
    selected = [b for b in bindings if b['compiler_artifact']['package_id'] == update_id
                and b['compiler_artifact']['target']['kind'] == ['test']
                and b['compiler_artifact']['target']['name'] == 'round']
    assert len(selected) == 1
    message = selected[0]['compiler_artifact']
    assert message['profile'] == PLAN['round_profile']
    assert message['features'] == PLAN['round_features']
    assert Path(message['target']['src_path']).resolve() == WT / 'lampOS/crates/update/tests/round.rs'
    listed = census.case_census(selected, {'packages': ['lamp-update']}, ENV, folder, WT)
    assert len(listed) == 1
    entry = listed[0]
    for case in PLAN['required_candidate_controls'] + PLAN['directed_cases']:
        assert entry['compiled_cases'].count(case) == 1
        assert case not in entry['compiled_ignored_cases']
    dump('round-binding.json', {'census': entry, 'artifact_binding': selected[0],
                               'file_identity': artifact(entry['executable']),
                               'profile_features_equal': True,
                               'inventory_scope': 'ONLY current actual round; no old157/58 baseline-census claim.'})


def controls():
    binding = json.loads((RUN_ROOT / 'round-binding.json').read_text())
    folder = RUN_ROOT / 'controls'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    outcomes = []
    try:
        for index, case in enumerate(PLAN['directed_cases'], 1):
            guard_source()
            guard_artifacts()
            assert artifact(binding['census']['executable']) == binding['file_identity']
            slot = folder / f'{index:02d}'
            slot.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
            # Exclusive sentinel is written BEFORE any launch. Any exception
            # consumes this planned slot; no retry path exists.
            with (slot / 'consumed.json').open('x') as stream:
                json.dump({'case': case, 'observations': 1, 'expected': PLAN['expected_control_outcome']}, stream)
            result = owned([binding['census']['executable'], '--exact', case, '--nocapture'],
                           slot, 'exact', 120)
            summary = census.execution_summary(result, slot)
            outcome = {'case': case, 'command': result, 'actual_summary': summary,
                       'expected': PLAN['expected_control_outcome']}
            outcomes.append(outcome)
            dump('directed-outcomes.json', outcomes)
            guard_source()
            guard_artifacts()
            totals = summary['totals']
            assert not result['timed_out']
            assert len(summary['rows']) == 1
            assert totals['passed'] == 1 and totals['failed'] == totals['ignored'] == totals['measured'] == 0
            assert totals['filtered_out'] == binding['census']['compiled_case_count'] - 1
            common.require_success(result)
            if PLAN['lane'] == 'old-counterfactual':
                text = (slot / result['stdout']).read_text() + (slot / result['stderr']).read_text()
                for token in ['EXPECTED TIMEOUT WITNESS', 'gate_cancelled_and_joined=true',
                              'releases=Ok([])', 'original_panic=updater fixture did not exit:']:
                    assert token in text, ('missing old witness receipt', token)
    finally:
        dump('directed-outcomes.json', outcomes)


def main():
    global PLAN, RUN_ROOT, WT, TARGET, ENV
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['clean-compile', 'inventory', 'controls'], required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--approval', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--plan', type=Path, default=SCRIPT_ROOT / 'execution-plan.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    planpath = args.plan.resolve()
    assert planpath.parent in {SCRIPT_ROOT, SCRIPT_ROOT / 'old-variant', SCRIPT_ROOT / 'restored-candidate'}
    RUN_ROOT = planpath.parent
    PLAN = json.loads(planpath.read_text())
    WT = Path(PLAN['worktree']).resolve()
    TARGET = Path(PLAN['target']).resolve()
    assert WT == SCRIPT_ROOT.parents[3] / 'update-events'
    assert PLAN['lane'] in {'candidate', 'old-counterfactual', 'restored-candidate'}
    if args.phase == 'controls':
        assert PLAN['directed_cases'], 'No directed reruns authorized after restore'
    approval = json.loads(args.approval.read_text())
    assert approval['phase'] == args.phase
    assert approval['execution_plan_sha256'] == common.sha(planpath.read_bytes())
    assert approval['controller_sha256'] == common.sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    assert approval['source_guard_sha256'] == PLAN['source_guard_sha256']
    assert approval['exclusive_CPU_target_allocation'] is True and approval['root_reviewed'] is True
    assert approval['target'] == str(TARGET)
    ENV = os.environ.copy()
    for key, value in PLAN['environment'].items():
        if value is None:
            ENV.pop(key, None)
        else:
            ENV[key] = value
    for key in list(ENV):
        if key.startswith(('CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_', 'CARGO_TARGET_ARM_')):
            ENV.pop(key)
    ENV['PATH'] = '/Users/autonomous/.cargo/bin' + os.pathsep + ENV['PATH']
    guard_source()
    if args.phase != 'clean-compile':
        guard_artifacts()
    with (RUN_ROOT / (args.phase + '-started.json')).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump({'approval': approval, 'started_at': common.now(), 'phase': args.phase}, stream)
    result = {'phase': args.phase, 'lane': PLAN['lane'], 'started_at': common.now(),
              'planned_directed_observations': len(PLAN['directed_cases']) if args.phase == 'controls' else 0}
    try:
        {'clean-compile': clean_compile, 'inventory': inventory, 'controls': controls}[args.phase]()
    except BaseException as error:
        result['exception'] = repr(error)
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            guard_source()
            if (RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile/local-provenance.json').exists():
                guard_artifacts()
            result['final_source_fullmode_mtime_guard'] = True
            result['sealed_artifacts_guard'] = (RUN_ROOT / 'clean-compile/local-provenance.json').exists()
        except BaseException as guard_error:
            result['final_guard_error'] = repr(guard_error)
            raise
        finally:
            if args.phase == 'controls':
                result['consumed_launch_allocations'] = len(list((RUN_ROOT / 'controls').glob('*/consumed.json')))
                outcomes_file = RUN_ROOT / 'directed-outcomes.json'
                result['completed_case_command_receipts'] = len(json.loads(outcomes_file.read_text())) if outcomes_file.exists() else 0
                result['unconsumed_planned_controls'] = len(PLAN['directed_cases']) - result['consumed_launch_allocations']
            result['finished_at'] = common.now()
            dump(args.phase + '-terminal.json', result)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

         'policy': 'Exact executable digest + full raw unit/profile/features/current source path; no old-e63/old-overlay census claim. Whole-source/artifact guards bracket the inventory phase, not each unrelated listing.'})
    guard_source()
    guard_latest_outputs()
    return actual


def run():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--approval', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    approval = json.loads(args.approval.read_text())
    assert approval['execution_plan_sha256'] == common.sha((ROOT / 'execution-plan.json').read_bytes())
    assert approval['controller_sha256'] == common.sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    assert approval['source_guard_sha256'] == SEED['source_guard_sha256']
    assert approval['exclusive_CPU_target_allocation'] is True and approval['root_reviewed'] is True
    assert approval['target'] == str(TARGET)
    guard_source()
    seed_provenance()
    seed_round_cache()
    with (ROOT / 'full-gates-started.json').open('x') as stream:
        json.dump({'approval': approval, 'started_at': common.now()}, stream)
    output = ROOT / 'run'
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    result = {'source_guard_sha256': SEED['source_guard_sha256'], 'started_at': common.now(),
              'steps': [], 'unrun_steps': [s['id'] for s in PLAN['steps']],
              'source_unchanged': False, 'no_clean_or_mtime_refresh': True,
              'native_Linux_or_ARM64_claim': False}
    all_passed = True
    exit_code = 1
    previous = {}
    def interrupted(signum, _frame):
        raise InterruptedError('Full runner received ' + signal.Signals(signum).name)
    try:
        for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
            previous[sig] = signal.getsignal(sig)
            signal.signal(sig, interrupted)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lamp-upd-', dir='/private/tmp') as temporary:
            with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as unix:
                unix.bind(str(Path(temporary) / 'p.sock'))
            with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as tcp:
                tcp.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
                tcp.listen(1)
        result['synthetic_local_socket_preflight'] = True
        for step in PLAN['steps']:
            guard_source()
            guard_latest_outputs()
            folder = output / step['id']
            folder.mkdir()
            entry = {'id': step['id'], 'state': 'running'}
            result['steps'].append(entry)
            result['unrun_steps'].remove(step['id'])
            dump(output / 'results.json', result)
            record = common.run_command(step['command'], WT / 'lampOS', ENV, folder,
                                        step['id'], step['timeout_seconds'])
            entry['command'] = record
            guard_source()
            assert record['owned_group_absent_after_cleanup'] and record['direct_wait_status'] == record['exit_code']
            if step['id'] == 'fmt-check':
                common.require_success(record)
            else:
                assert census.compile_outcome(record, folder)['successful']
                bindings = compile_records(record, folder)
                if step.get('test_packages'):
                    summary = census.execution_summary(record, folder)
                    entry['actual_execution_summary'] = summary
                    assert not record['timed_out'] and record['exit_code'] in (0, 101)
                    packages = step['test_packages']
                    inventories = current_inventories(bindings, packages, folder)
                    outcomes = census.target_outcomes(record, folder, inventories, packages, packages, WT)
                    entry['complete_case_target_binding'] = outcomes['complete_binding']
                    assert outcomes['complete_binding'], outcomes['binding_errors']
                    assert (record['exit_code'] == 0) == (summary['totals']['failed'] == 0)
                    if 'lamp-update' in packages:
                        controls = [{'name': name, 'status': status} for target in outcomes['targets']
                                    for name, status in target.get('test_rows', []) if name in PLAN['component_cases']]
                        assert sorted(c['name'] for c in controls) == sorted(PLAN['component_cases'])
                        entry['preplanned_fullsuite_component_reexecution'] = controls
                        assert not any(PLAN['old_case'] in target.get('compiled_cases', []) for target in inventories)
                    all_passed &= record['exit_code'] == 0
                else:
                    common.require_success(record)
            entry['state'] = 'passed' if record['exit_code'] == 0 else 'FAILED actual tests, retained; no waiver/retry'
            guard_source()
            guard_latest_outputs()
            dump(output / 'results.json', result)
        result['status'] = 'All planned local gates passed' if all_passed else 'FAILED local tests; independent planned gates completed'
        exit_code = 0 if all_passed else 1
    except BaseException as error:
        result['status'] = 'Stopped on source/infrastructure/compile/non-test gate/timeout/census failure; no retry'
        result['error'] = repr(error)
        (output / 'exception.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:
            guard_source()
            guard_latest_outputs()
            result['source_unchanged'] = True
            result['local_output_epoch_guard'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            result['final_guard_error'] = repr(error)
            exit_code = 1
        for sig, handler in previous.items():
            signal.signal(sig, handler)
        result['finished_at'] = common.now()
        result['runner_exit'] = exit_code
        dump(output / 'results.json', result)
    return exit_code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(run())
